args.body: Reconcile the queued funding.html FETCH against the existing NLnet allowance before any further retrieval. If committed, read the exact eligibility and milestone wording alongside the dated call. Reuse csv-core-baseline.json if committed and if the CSV checker fits the call. Read the observed exit code and output before citing it. On a supported fit, prepare one measurable public-benefit milestone with an executed acceptance check and a justified request. If a decisive condition remains unresolved, record the source wording, affected application step and specific reopening evidence. Read back the artifacts and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission or spending.
